mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the skin was the most worthwhile moment: the practical frame became a recognizable whale, with a blue belly and translucent fins.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the stop-button guide was the least engaging passage; it was a clear but routine intermediate fastening step.

surprise.text: The extension struts bridge the gap to the lower frame without changing the original supports, and the short electrical leads then need extending.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The goals named each operation, although some routine fittings needed little thought beyond following the instruction.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue to see the completed whale used, especially after its frame became a whale and its lift module was secured.
